verdict.rationale: Lighthouse ships its own case-preparation platform with a UI for uploading documents and tracking readiness, so API parity is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions a public API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt (all paths returned 404). No documentation shows that UI actions are available programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
